title: ProductInput
description:
A product.

The smallest valid product is `{"title": "Blue shirt", "price": 1999}`: it gets a single
default variant, like a product without options in the Shopify admin.

$schema.description: Lets editors validate and autocomplete the file, e.g. `"../schema/product.schema.json"`.

id.description: Generated from the handle when omitted.

handle.description:
The URL slug (`/products/<handle>`). Derived from the title when omitted. In a
`products/<name>.json` file it defaults to the file name.

options.description:
Option names, e.g. `["Size", "Color"]`. At most three. Omit for a product with a
single default variant.

variants.description: The variants. Each must give one value per option.

price.description: Price of the variants that do not set their own, and of the default variant.

compare_at_price.description: Compare-at price of the variants that do not set their own.

images.description: Shorthand for image-only media. Use `media` for videos and 3D models.

media.description: Images, videos and models in display order. When set, `images` must be empty.

available.description: Shorthand to set availability on every variant that does not say otherwise.

collections.description:
Handles of the collections this product belongs to, in addition to the collections
that list it in their own `products`.

gift_card.description: Whether the product is a gift card (`product.gift_card?`).

recommendations.description:
Handles of the products returned by product recommendations for this product.
Defaults to other products from the same collections.

selling_plan_groups.description:
Names of the selling plan groups (from `selling_plan_groups`) this product is sold
with, in addition to the groups that list it in their own `products`.

requires_selling_plan.description:
Whether the product can only be bought with a selling plan, like a product sold by
subscription only. Defaults to `false`.

OptionInput.description: A product option. Write just the name (`"Size"`); the values are collected from the variants.

OptionDetail.description: A product option with its values in a chosen order.

values.description:
The values in display order. Defaults to the order they appear in the variants. A
value is its name (`"White"`), or its name with a swatch
(`{"name": "White", "swatch": "#ffffff"}`).

OptionValueInput.description: A value of a product option: its name, or its name with a swatch.

OptionValueDetail.description: A value of a product option with its swatch (`product_option_value.swatch`).

swatch.description:
The swatch of the value on this product. Defaults to the swatch the store's
`swatches` give to this name.

SwatchInput.description:
How an option value is shown instead of its name: a CSS color (`"#f4f1ea"`), or an object
with a color, an image, or both.

SwatchDetail.description: A swatch with a color, an image, or both (`swatch.color`, `swatch.image`).

image.description: An image, for a pattern that a single color cannot show.

ImageInput.description:
An image: either just its source, or an object with more detail.

The source is a path inside the `files/` directory of the data directory
(`"shirt.jpg"` → `files/shirt.jpg`). When no such file exists a placeholder of the declared
size is generated, so fixtures work without shipping real images.

src.description: Path of the image inside `files/`, e.g. `"products/shirt-front.jpg"`.

alt.description: Alternative text. Defaults to an empty string.

width.description: Width in pixels. Read from the file when it exists, otherwise defaults to 1200.

height.description: Height in pixels. Read from the file when it exists, otherwise defaults to 1200.

focal_point.description: The focal point as percentages from the top-left corner, e.g. `{"x": 50, "y": 20}`.

FocalPoint.description: The point of an image that should stay visible when it is cropped.

id.description: Generated from the product handle and the variant's position when omitted.

title.description: Defaults to the option values joined with ` / ` (`"Small / Blue"`).

options.description: One value per product option, in the order of the product's `options`.

compare_at_price.description: The price before a sale. Must be higher than `price` to show as a discount.

sku.description: Also a convenient way to reference the variant from carts and orders.

available.description: Whether the variant can be bought. Derived from the inventory fields when omitted.

inventory_quantity.description: Units in stock. Setting it turns inventory tracking on.

inventory_tracked.description:
Set to `false` to disable inventory tracking (the variant is then always available).
Defaults to `true` when `inventory_quantity` is set, `false` otherwise.

weight_unit.description: The unit the weight is displayed in: `g`, `kg`, `oz` or `lb`. Defaults to `kg`.

image.description: The `src` of the product image that shows this variant.

store_availabilities.description:
The locations (from `locations`, by name) that stock this variant, and whether it is in
stock there: `{"Portland": true, "Seattle": false}`. When omitted, every location stocks
the variant, and it is in stock there when the variant is available.

Money.description: An amount of money: an integer number of cents (`1999`, the unit Liquid uses) or a decimal string in the shop currency (`"19.99"`). Floats such as `19.99` are rejected because they are ambiguous.

InventoryPolicy.description: What happens when a tracked variant is out of stock.

oneOf.description: Stop selling when the stock reaches zero.
Keep selling when out of stock.

UnitPriceMeasurement.description: What a unit price refers to, e.g. 250 g priced per 100 g.

QuantityRule.description: The quantities a variant can be bought in (`variant.quantity_rule`).

max.description: Maximum quantity. No maximum when omitted.

increment.description: Quantities must be a multiple of this. Defaults to 1.

QuantityPriceBreak.description: A volume price: the unit price from a given quantity.

MetafieldInput.description:
A metafield value. Write the value directly and its type is inferred (string →
`single_line_text_field`, integer → `number_integer`, decimal → `number_decimal`, boolean →
`boolean`, anything else → `json`), or spell out `{"type": ..., "value": ...}`.

TypedMetafield.description: A metafield with an explicit type.

type.description:
A Shopify metafield type, e.g. `single_line_text_field`, `multi_line_text_field`,
`rich_text_field`, `number_integer`, `number_decimal`, `boolean`, `color`, `date`,
`date_time`, `url`, `json`, `money`, `rating`, `weight`, `volume`, `dimension` and the
other measurements (`distance`, `temperature`, `duration`...), `product_reference`,
`collection_reference`, `page_reference`, `article_reference` (`blog/article`, or the
article's handle alone), `file_reference`, `metaobject_reference`, or a `list.` variant
of those.

value.description:
The value. References are written as handles (`"blue-shirt"`), files as paths inside
`files/`, lists as JSON arrays.

MediaInput.description: A piece of product media. Images can be written as a plain string.

MediaDetail.description: A video, an external (YouTube/Vimeo) video or a 3D model.

preview_image.description: The image shown before the media plays.

sources.description: `video` and `model`: the files, by decreasing preference.

external_id.description: `external_video`: the id of the video on the host, e.g. `dQw4w9WgXcQ`.

aspect_ratio.description: Width divided by height. Defaults to the preview image's ratio, or 16:9.

MediaType.description: The kind of a piece of media that is not an image.

MediaSource.description: One file of a video or 3D model.

url.description: Path inside `files/` or an absolute URL.

VideoHost.description: Where an external video is hosted.
